L2: # Connect HubSpot to Explee
L3: 
L4: Explee sends every hot lead to HubSpot the moment it appears. Each hot lead becomes a contact and a deal in the pipeline you choose, with the full outreach conversation logged on the timeline. Your team works leads in HubSpot as usual — no copy-paste, no CSV imports.
L5: 
L6: ## Before you start
L7: 
L8:   * A HubSpot account where you can install apps (super admin, or a user with App Marketplace access).
L9:   * An Explee project with outreach running.
L10: ## Setup
L11: 
L12:   1. 1
L13: 
L14: Open Integrations in your project
L15: 
L16: In Explee, open your project and go to Settings → Integrations.
L17: 
L18:   2. 2
L19: 
L20: Click Connect HubSpot
L21: 
L22: You will be redirected to HubSpot. Sign in and pick the account you want to connect.
L23: 
L24:   3. 3
L25: 
L26: Review permissions and approve
L27: 
L28: HubSpot shows the access Explee requests: contacts, companies, and deals. Click Connect app.
L29: 
L30:   4. 4
L31: 
L32: Choose a pipeline and stage
L33: 
L34: Back in Explee, pick where new deals should land. New hot leads use this pipeline from then on.
L35: 
L36:   5. 5
L37: Sync your existing hot leads (optional)
L38: 
L39: Click Sync to push hot leads you already have. Leads that are already in HubSpot are skipped.
L40: ## Data Explee accesses
L41: 
L42: The integration uses HubSpot OAuth with the minimum set of permissions:
L43: 
L44: HubSpot data  | Access  | Used for
L45: --- | --- | ---
L46: Contacts  | Read and write  | Create the hot lead as a contact; match by email to avoid duplicates
L47: Companies  | Read and write  | Attach the lead's company; match by domain to avoid duplicates
L48: Deals  | Read and write  | Create the deal and list your pipelines for the stage picker
L49: ## FAQ
L50: 
L51: Which leads does Explee send to HubSpot?
L52: 
L53: Hot leads only — people who replied to your outreach with interest. Explee does not copy your whole lead list into HubSpot.
L54: 
L55: What does Explee create in HubSpot?
L56: 
L57: A contact (name, title, company, LinkedIn), a company, and a deal in the pipeline you chose. The deal timeline gets a note with the reason the lead is hot and the full email conversation.
L58: 
L59: Will I get duplicates?
L60: No. Contacts are matched by email and companies by domain. A lead that replies twice still produces one contact and one deal.
L61: 
L62: Does Explee read my CRM data?
L63: 
L64: Explee only searches contacts and companies to prevent duplicates, and reads your deal pipelines so you can pick a stage. It never reads deal contents, emails, or other records.
L65: 
L66: How do I disconnect?
L67: Go to Settings → Integrations and click Disconnect. Explee revokes its own access on the HubSpot side. You can also uninstall the app from HubSpot under Settings → Integrations → Connected apps.
L68: 
L69: What does it cost?
L70: 
L71: The HubSpot integration is included at no extra cost on every Explee plan except Starter.
L72: ### Need help?

L9: ## Endpoints
L10: ### `POST` /public/api/v1/search/companies
L11: 
L12: Companies
L13: Search for companies using structured definitions. ## How It Works Provide a structured definition of your target companies in the `definition` field — our AI will find matching companies. All other filters are optional. See the request schema below for the full list of available filters.
L14: **Definition examples:** - `"YouTube video summarization tool"` - `"electronic signature platform"` - `"AI B2B SaaS"` - `"real estate company"` ## AI Enrichment Use the `criteria` parameter to score companies against custom criteria. Each company will be evaluated and scored (0-5) with reasoning for each criterion.
L15: ## Pricing - **First 10 results are free** (including AI enrichment) - A **positive credit balance is required for every request**, free results included (an organization at 0 credits gets a 402) - Entirely-free requests are limited per organization by plan: **free 50/day + 10/min · starter 200/day + 15/min · growth 500/day + 20/min · pro 750/day + 25/min · agency 1500/day + 30/min · enterprise 3000/day + 30/min** (429 beyond); billable requests are not affected - **0.5 credits** per company after the first 10 - **+0.1 credits** per company per criterion after the first 10 Example: 150 companies with 2 criteria = 50 billable × (0.5 + 0.1 × 2) = 35 credits (first 10 are free) Empty results = 0 credits.
L16: ## Deduplication Pass dedup list ids in `exclude_lists` to skip companies you already own — they are not returned and not charged. Free results zone does not apply. See the Deduplication endpoints.

L177: Check progress and retrieve results for a find-and-enrich job. **Statuses (in meta.status):** - `pending` — running; read `meta.progress` (incl. `eta_seconds`) and poll again - `completed` — results ready; `contacts` holds the enriched contacts, `meta.next_cursor`/`meta.has_more` for paging - `failed` — error occurred (or timed out — credits released), see `meta.error` Only contacts with a found email are returned. `meta.credits_charged` reflects found emails only.

L182:   * `200`: Successful Response

L184:   * `402`: Insufficient credit balance. Every request needs a positive balance, including requests that fall entirely inside the free results zone. Top up your account.

L188:   * `504`: Request timeout. Please try again later.

L190: ### `GET` /public/api/v1/tasks
L191: 
L192: List async tasks
L193: List all async tasks for your organization, including find-and-enrich jobs, batch email enrichments, and campaign lead imports. **Use cases:** - Track async jobs across every API key owned by the same organization - Find task IDs you may have lost - Monitor pending vs completed tasks **Response:** - `tasks` — array of task objects with status and result URL - `total` — total count for pagination **Filtering:** - Use `status` parameter to filter by task status (pending, completed, failed)
